description: Department heads meet with governors over emergency declarations and with mayors over cuts to city services.

slots.disaster: The incident named in the emergency offer.
slots.deadline: The day the emergency offer expires.
slots.cut: The amount taken from the adopted budget line.
slots.line: The service named on the budget line.
slots.percent: The percentage cut from that line.

parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Tell her we have to check her block against the money that's left. Give me the street name and I'll get her an answer.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: What would you want me to look at before I vote to put money back into roads?
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'd start with a cross section. You can see the pavement from your car. You can't see what holds it up.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: If I bring the road money up again, how do I keep from asking for the same thing twice?
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Show them the first cut and the money they put back on separate lines. The difference is what I'm asking for.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Say council leaves the road money where it is. What do we owe the people who asked for work?
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: An answer about their own street. Let me check each request before we tell anyone to expect a crew.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Take down her street name. I'll ask council for the money back, and I'll call her myself when we know about her block.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Give her my number. I'll explain why I'm leaving the road budget where it is.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll ask for half the cut. Then let's see how far down the street list that gets us.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Let me get her address before we go any further.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Bring the drawing. I'll sponsor the amendment and you can walk us through it.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I understand there's work underneath. I'm still voting to keep the cut.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Suppose I can get half back. Show me what that would cover on your drawing.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Let me look at that cross section before I take a side.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Give me the difference. That's the amount I'll take back to council.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Keep both figures on the sheet. I'm sticking with what council put back.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Split what's still missing in half. I'll take that smaller request to the members.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Leave me your copy. I want to check the two votes before I answer.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll ask for the rest of the road money. In the meantime, people can call my office about their block.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I can tell them why I'm keeping the budget here. Send the calls my way.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll back half of what's still missing. Let's see which requests we'd still have to turn down.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'd like to read those requests myself. Hold off on putting my name on an amendment.
parts.author: Codex writer A
